name: memory-maintenance
description: Consolidate Alistair's long-term memory so it stays clean and trustworthy. Trigger whenever {user} asks to tidy, consolidate, or deduplicate memory, or as a light periodic pass. The server supplies deterministic candidates but never makes semantic decisions; the connected model resolves duplicates and conflicts without inventing facts.
instructions:
# Memory maintenance (Alistair)

The append-only store keeps one folded active version per canonical memory. Exact repeats become confirmation events. For new writes, the server searches the full active store deterministically and returns at most three candidates; you, the connected model, make the semantic decision from only those candidates.

## Procedure
1. Pull the full store only for an explicit maintenance pass using `search_memory` with an empty query. Normal writes must use the candidate shortlist instead.
2. Cluster obvious paraphrases, stale versions, contradictions, transient junk, and over-pinned entries.
3. Choose the supported current canonical wording and relevance: 5 permanent cross-client identity/address-form, safety, tool-ownership, or core-workflow invariants; 4 durable important but situational; 3 default durable context; 2 narrow/uncertain/deferred; 1 normally route elsewhere. Ask {user} when a conflict cannot be resolved from evidence.
4. Apply each change through the two-stage `save_memory` protocol. `possible_duplicate` means no write occurred. Retry with `resolution=refresh` for the same meaning, `resolution=supersede` for outdated information, `resolution=create` only when both genuinely belong, or `resolution=conflict` to leave it unwritten. Use returned `target_memory_id`; do not resend or guess an old memory.
5. Retract transient/experiment data by `target_memory_id`; route tasks/logistics to the in-tray or Notion. Do not use `explicitly_requested=true` unless {user} actually requested that exact guarded exception.
6. Verify with `get_memory` and targeted `search_memory` queries. Reads never refresh confirmation time.

## Guardrails
Never invent or improve a fact beyond evidence. Never silently delete uncertain personal data. Preserve append-only history. Report created, refreshed, superseded, retracted, and conflict-left-unwritten outcomes accurately.

sections.heading: When to run
sections.body: On request; as a light periodic pass; or after a large import. Normal writes should never pull the full store because save_memory returns a bounded deterministic shortlist.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body: Pull the full store only for maintenance. Resolve each candidate with refresh, supersede, create/keep-both, or conflict and its stable target_memory_id. Retract transient junk by id, then verify with get_memory and targeted search.

sections.heading: Guardrails
sections.body: Never invent facts or silently delete uncertain personal data. Reads never refresh. relevance 5 is only for permanent cross-client invariants; guarded transient exceptions require an explicit user request.
